scope: Current immutable GUI deployments; no application changes or deployment restart. Separate initial preparation from repeated prepared opens and retained navigation.
methodology: Four sequential fresh-browser captures: two Riemann, then two EthLib. Normal motion, 1440x960, no throttling. Native CPU sampling runs alongside browser profiling, and adds overhead. No validation jobs run during captures.

Dispatch measures synchronous EventDispatch time. Input/two-rAF is a browser scheduling/presentation proxy, not physical presentation or field INP. Small within-run p95 values are diagnostic. Eight-event p95 is the maximum.

The first of eight same-node clicks differs from seven repeats; eight following clicks alternate two distinct reachable declarations and must display the original selected source line. Individual dispatch times and target IDs are retained.

All seven actual served JavaScript bundles were verified byte-for-byte against the source-map build; each executable and raw artifact digest was checked. Local raw captures contain source paths and stay under target/. No model requests are issued.
Completed native intervals overlap; never sum nested stages. Current-thread CPU excludes child workers. Wall minus thread CPU is not an I/O-wait counter. Ring evictions are reported.
A zero-count percentile is unknown/null in this record, even though the older raw profiler uses zero placeholders. Native queue CPU is deliberately unavailable.

Idle request intervals are request start-to-start and response_ms is Playwright responseEnd relative to request start. Bytes are uncompressed loopback response body bytes. No cache condition is inferred solely from elapsed time.
Hover/resize/tab and each node selection preserve the graph transform. Deliberate drag/Fit View changes are expected. This scenario does not reproduce every possible camera-reset sequence.

Browser automation queries and hit-testing contribute sampled CPU; do not assign all query/anonymous cost to the application. Compared with historical captures, host/cache conditions vary: this is not a controlled speedup/regression experiment.
limits: Existing Lean/project dependencies are installed. Initial artifact preparation is not cold installation. No local-inference, confidentiality, refinement or general device-performance claim.
No chat message was sent. Model response/streaming latency, tool execution during chat, arbitrary huge declaration graphs and mobile devices are not measured.
Unfinished generic-reader worktree changes are deliberately excluded; this record identifies the exact running executable/assets. The wider implementation goal remains open.
state_payload_snapshot_scope: Separate read-only state observation during the final EthLib capture. Sizes are UTF-8 JSON re-serialization of each decoded field; captured HTTP response sizes/timings remain authoritative for network comparisons. No contents are published.

initial_gate_attempt.note: The outer execution wrapper terminated, while the detached public test child completed with all 34 cases passed. The complete gate was repeated under a detached exit monitor and returned zero; no test/configuration rescue was used.

outcomes: Lake manifest/inventory rejection, retained historical restart
